## Current Stream DEM workflow

The normal Survey Events page processes assigned Streams from saved settings and
shows each result in a Stream tab within one DEMs card. It needs no development
fixture or single-Stream option. Optional DEM details are unbordered; queue messages
appear only for actual processing, failure or pause. Waiting and Ready remain
internal states and do not measure drawing time.

`survey_event_settings_server()` supplies context to `survey_event_dems_server()`.
The latter serializes all assigned Streams through one `terrain_dem_trial_job()`
with a saved-record request factory. It waits for automatic masks, reuses matching
editions, advances after success/failure, and pauses remaining work on cancel.
Resume retries only unfinished Streams. Each tab uses a display-only
`terrain_mosaic_trial_server()` that cannot launch a worker.

## Source selection, request and worker

`terrain_dem_request()` constructs the active Stream request from saved Study
geometry, Event membership, file selections, mask/grid and vertical target.
`terrain_dem_sources()` resolves member Collections through the store's request
adapter and acquisition reader, preserving saved file order as source precedence.
Missing acquisitions or unavailable files route to Collections > DEM files.
Receipt reopening checks existence/size against retained transfer evidence;
selection identities are rechecked before publication and ordinary reuse.

`launch_terrain_dem_trial()` in `R/terrain_dem_trial.R` calls fluvgeo
`mosaic_terrain_tiles()` -> `mask_terrain_mosaic()` ->
`terrain_to_international_feet()` in one worker. The source-CRS extent participates
in recipe identity. Native file-backed crop/merge uses first-valid precedence,
then applies the saved Stream mask and divides NAVD88 metres by 0.3048. Output is
Float32 with vertical EPSG:8228. The exercised source/Event grids already align;
this path performs neither resampling nor a datum transformation. Differing grids
and other vertical operations remain unsupported here.

## Publication and reopening

`local_study_store()` delegates to `study_dem_store()` in `R/study_dem_store.R`.
The job uses Study-owned staging, rechecks current binding/recipe, then publishes
an immutable edition by directory rename. Cancellation, edits or session close
stop workers before owned staging cleanup; completed editions are retained.
Full Stream/Reach output grids are checked against the corresponding saved mask.

`find_dem(binding, recipe=NULL, stream_id=NULL, scope=NULL)` filters each normal
result tab to its Stream. Reopening checks the record and raster presence/size,
without a repeated pixel/hash scan. Available intermediate paths resolve inside
the edition; missing intermediates in older final-only editions are not invented.

FGDB ADR-0025 requires filesystem GeoTIFF DEMs with GeoPackage vectors/tables and
linked metadata. The internal RDS edition index does not complete portable folder
binding or enterprise transfer. Follow `dev/workflows/r-spatial.md` to the accepted
storage decision and completed Esri findings before changing raster persistence.
The exact app contract is `dev/schemas/survey-event-dem.md`.

## Development and verification

The normal Event queue is separate from optional bounded diagnostics. A configured
`fgstudio.dem_reach` or `fgstudio.dem_stream` targets one saved record; an explicit
`fgstudio.mosaic_trial` fixture supports older real-window trials. These are not
production size limits. Earlier Reach/portion editions remain readable.
`fgstudio.mask_diagnostics` is disabled by default to avoid mask-display work.

Use small actual downloaded DEM windows, not synthetic rasters or repeated full
Stream builds, for parameter development. The feature record consolidates measured
runs: full R1, mainstem and both tributaries. The three 2019-12 Stream editions have
been reopened; the Event run reused mainstem and processed tributaries serially.

Trace tests `test-survey-event-dems.R`, `test-terrain-dem-trial.R`,
`test-terrain-dem-request.R`, `test-terrain-dem-sources.R`,
`test-study-dem-store.R` and `test-terrain-mosaic-trial.R`. Real raster checks are
opt-in; lifecycle tests use mock process handles with the existing real fixture.
Backend scientific tests and the terrain-tile-mosaic contract belong to fluvgeo.

## Horizontal warp primitive

`fluvgeo::warp_terrain_horizontal()` is an existing backend primitive; there is no
current FG Studio caller or new analyst approval step. It takes a source GeoTIFF,
a template defining the output grid, and a new output directory. Template values
are not applied as a mask.

The implementation uses native GDAL warping with an explicit horizontal pipeline
and `-novshift`. This option matters: the installed GDAL control test converts
compound US-survey-foot heights to metres under a default warp to a 2D metre CRS.
The guarded operation preserves the height units and retains source declarations.
It does not perform a vertical transformation or certify source suitability.

Aligned grids use nearest sampling; other grids use bilinear interpolation.
Float32 is the storage default and Float64 is optional. GDAL chooses working
precision and memory settings. Native terra summaries replace custom R block
traversal and the broken deleted-helper dependency. Exact sample comparisons
remain in small independent tests, not a second exhaustive production audit.
There are no application cell-count, row-width or estimated-disk admission caps.

GDAL handles affine source rotation and unequal spacing. Ordinary overviews are
allowed, but analytical warping uses base pixels to avoid inheriting an unknown
overview resampling method. The output template must be north-up. The retained
operation profile supports static east/north projected CRSs with the same identified
geodetic base; datum/epoch changes, nonidentity scale/offset and external
georeferencing/mask sidecars still need explicit implementation. These are API
scope boundaries, not universal GIS restrictions.

Trace sibling fluvgeo `R/warp_terrain_horizontal.R`,
`tests/testthat/test_warp_terrain_horizontal.R` and
`dev/schemas/horizontal-terrain-warp.md`. Tests retain independent interpolation,
NoData, unit-conversion controls, crop/extension and wide-grid cases. Source and
output hashes, metadata, native summaries and software/options are recorded before
the final manifest is written. No shared library is upgraded.

The unmounted [source-review module](dev-14-source-review.html) is not an analyst
approval prerequisite. Integrating this primitive still requires qualification
of the intended source/Event operation and preservation of vertical evidence.
